subject.title: feat(chat-ui): inline diffs for edit and write tool rows

question: Should the shared Apple renderer be completed to match the web renderer’s conservative tool-kind and authoritative-result safeguards, rather than landing argument-derived exact diffstats for ambiguous writes and outcomes?
rationale: The feature direction is already established by the merged predecessor, but whether ambiguous tool arguments may be presented as an applied diff is a user-trust and shared-client behavior choice that should be owner-reviewed.

options.title: Complete conservative parity
options.body: Preserve bounded authoritative data and show exact diffstats only for recognized successful edits with sufficient applied-result evidence.

options.title: Narrow the initial scope
options.body: Render only recognized persisted result diffs now and leave fallback reconstruction for a separately reviewed follow-up.

recommendation.title: Complete conservative parity
recommendation.body: Preserve bounded authoritative data and show exact diffstats only for recognized successful edits with sufficient applied-result evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged shared tool-row architecture and are best positioned to choose the narrowest compatible follow-up shape.
